name: Marco
title:
Red's K.O. power with blue's hand manipulation!
The {Whitebeard Pirates} return with this deck!
desc:
By working with the Leader effect, you can make good use of cards that play Characters from atop your deck and cards that K.O. opponent Characters in this Marco deck.

Changing your hand with each turn, you'll be able to achieve stable performance.

cards.name: Marco
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Draw 1 card and place 1 card from your hand at the top or bottom of your deck. Then, give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Otama
cards.text: [On Play] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Izo
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 card with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" other than [Izo] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Namule
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On Play] Draw 2 cards and place 2 cards from your hand at the top or bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Jozu
cards.text:
[DON!! x1] If you have 2 or less Life cards and your Leader's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates", this Character gains [Rush].
(This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)

cards.name: Marco
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On K.O.] You may trash 1 card with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" from your hand: If you have 2 or less Life cards, play this Character card from your trash rested.

cards.name: Atmos
cards.text: [On Play] You may reveal 2 cards with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" from your hand: If your Leader's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates", return up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less to the owner's hand.

cards.name: Kingdew
cards.text: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may reveal 2 cards with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" from your hand: This Character gains +2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Thatch
cards.text: If this Character would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect or K.O.'d, trash this Character and draw 1 card instead.

cards.name: Portgas.D.Ace
cards.text: [On Play] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck and play up to 1 Character card with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" and a cost of 4 or less. Then, place the rest at the top or bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Jozu
cards.text: [On Play] You may return 1 of your Characters other than this Character to the owner's hand: Return up to 1 Character with a cost of 6 or less to the owner's hand.

cards.name: Portgas.D.Ace
cards.text:
[On Play] Give up to 2 of your opponent's Characters −3000 power during this turn. Then, if your Leader's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates", this Character gains [Rush] during this turn.
(This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)

cards.name: Silvers Rayleigh
cards.text: [On Play] Select up to 2 of your opponent's Characters, and give 1 Character −3000 power and the other −2000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn. Then, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 3000 power or less.

cards.name: Edward.Newgate
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates" and you have 2 or less Life cards, select all of your opponent's Characters on their field. Until the end of your opponent's next turn, none of the selected Characters can attack unless your opponent trashes 2 cards from their hand whenever they attack.

cards.name: Radical Beam!!
cards.text: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle. Then, if you have 2 or less Life cards, that card gains an additional +2000 power.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +1000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Phoenix Brand
cards.text: [Main] You may reveal 2 cards with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" from your hand: Place up to 1 Character with a cost of 6 or less at the bottom of the owner's deck.
